Thick_Silverback_Fur_Integument.description: This entity is cloaked in a dense, silver-black fur that acts as a formidable natural armor, providing unparalleled protection and resilience against the harshest elements and physical attacks, while also bestowing a remarkable resistance to cold and the ability to block incoming strikes effectively.

Sleek_Monkey_Pelt.description: This sleek pelt, harvested from a rare jungle primate, enhances the wearer's agility and speed, granting them superior evasion skills and the ability to traverse challenging terrains with ease, as if the very earth itself parts to accommodate their swift, silent footsteps.

Golden_Lion_Tamarin_Mane.description: The Golden Lion Tamarin Mane is a radiant and vibrant integumentary component, shimmering with golden hues that enhance the charisma of its bearer, granting them unparalleled charm and the ability to intimidate foes with its majestic presence.

Hairless_Chimp_Leathery_Skin.description: This leathery skin, reminiscent of a hairless chimp's tough hide, grants its bearer a natural armor that deflects blows and a surprising dexterity, while also bestowing a resistance to the searing touch of flames, making it both a shield and a safeguard against the infernal.

Camouflage_Lemur_Pelt.description: The Camouflage Lemur Pelt is a supple, mottled hide that enhances the wearer's ability to blend seamlessly with their surroundings, granting them exceptional stealth and agility in the dense, shadowy forests of the realm.

Mandrill_War_Paint_Hide.description: The Mandrill_War_Paint_Hide is a vibrant, primal exoskeleton that enhances the wearer's Charisma and Strength, allowing them to channel the fierce spirit of the mandrill and unleash intimidating displays that strike fear into the hearts of enemies.

Spectral_Ape_Ghost_Integument.description: The Spectral Ape Ghost Integument is a translucent, ethereal skin that grants the wearer a ghostly presence, allowing them to blend into shadows with eerie perfection and resist piercing attacks, while also enhancing their charm and stealth capabilities.

Thick_Baboon_Calloused_Hide.description: This thick baboon hide, calloused and tough as ancient oak, forms a natural armor that deflects even the sharpest of blades, endowing its bearer with the raw strength and resilience of the wild primate.

Aquatic_Macaque_Oiled_Pelt.description: This sleek and supple pelt, naturally oiled and thick with a primate's resilience, enhances the wearer's constitution and agility in the water, granting the ability to breathe underwater and perform swift, powerful swimming dashes.

Zombie_Primate_Rotting_Skin.description: The rotting skin of the Zombie Primate is a loathsome, moldering layer that emits a noxious cloud of toxic spores, enhancing the creature's resilience and mental fortitude while poisoning its foes.
